channel.title: Macwan Apps Blog
channel.description: Notes from an indie iOS studio — launches, lessons, and what it's like building apps solo. By Jobin Macwan.

item.title: Doomscrolling: why your brain can't stop — and the fix that isn't willpower
item.description: Doomscrolling isn't a discipline problem — it's a design problem. The psychology behind the loop, and the friction-based fix that actually works.

item.title: A realistic healthy daily schedule for people with desk jobs
item.description: No 5am club, no two-hour routines — a sustainable daily structure built around movement, light, and a phone that knows its place.

item.title: How much screen time is too much? An honest answer
item.description: There's no magic number of hours. Three questions that matter more than any average.

item.title: What 30 minutes of walking a day actually changes
item.description: The realistic benefits of a daily 30-minute walk — mood, sleep, blood pressure, creativity — from someone who builds walking software for a living.

item.title: Is 10,000 steps a myth? What the science actually says
item.description: 10,000 steps started as pedometer marketing, not medicine. What step-count research really shows, and how to pick a goal that fits you.

item.title: Introducing WalkFirst: your steps are the key to your apps
item.description: Why I built an app that blocks distracting apps until you've walked enough — and how Apple's Screen Time framework makes it possible without your data ever leaving your phone.

item.title: Introducing Rockiva: point your camera at a rock, learn what it is
item.description: An AI-powered rock and gem identifier that gives you real mineralogy instead of a guess — localized in 35 languages, including the AI's answers themselves.
